# Observation Type

- **CURIE:** [`gmeow:ObservationType`](gmeow-ObservationType.md)
- **IRI:** <https://blackcatinformatics.ca/gmeow/ObservationType>
- **Category:** class
- **Defined by:** [`gmeow:slices/observations`](../../slices/observations.md)
- **Box roles:** [TBox role](../boxes/tbox.md) ([What is this?](../../four-boxes/index.md))

The kind of observation being made — a value vocabulary (individuals, never subclasses). Distinguishes measurement, sensory reading, standpoint claim, derived inference, and simulation output. The specific sub-discipline (radiocarbon dating, GPS survey, temperature sensing) is [`gmeow:observationMethod`](../properties/gmeow-observationMethod.md), not [`gmeow:observationType`](../properties/gmeow-observationType.md).

## Structure

**Subclass of:** [`gufo:QualityValue`](../../external/terms.md#gufo-qualityvalue)

## Practical Pattern

Use [`gmeow:ObservationType`](gmeow-ObservationType.md) as a specialized kind of [`gufo:QualityValue`](../../external/terms.md#gufo-qualityvalue). Add statement metadata or a standpoint when the assertion needs provenance, confidence, or vantage.

## Usage Advice

### Use when

- Use as the value vocabulary behind [`gmeow:observationType`](../properties/gmeow-observationType.md) — the open set of individuals naming the broad KIND of observation (measurement, sensory reading, standpoint claim, derived inference, simulation, identity, naming, rights, kinship, streaming).

### Avoid when

- Avoid minting per-type subclasses (types are individuals) and avoid using it for the specific protocol or discipline (that is [`gmeow:ObservationMethod`](gmeow-ObservationMethod.md)); the type is the category, not the technique.

### How to use

- Reference the seeded type individuals via the non-functional [`gmeow:observationType`](../properties/gmeow-observationType.md) (an observation may carry several), and let the sub-discipline ride on [`gmeow:observationMethod`](../properties/gmeow-observationMethod.md) and the typed-claim distinction on the [`Observation`](gmeow-Observation.md) subclass.

### Examples

- ex:reading [`gmeow:observationType`](../properties/gmeow-observationType.md) [`gmeow:observationTypeMeasurement`](../individuals/gmeow-observationTypeMeasurement.md).
